task: Classify microsatellite instability status in colorectal adenocarcinoma. Classes: MSI vs. MSS. Key H&E indicators of MSI include abundant tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, mucinous or medullary features, poor differentiation, and pushing growth pattern, whereas MSS tumors more often appear as conventional gland-forming adenocarcinomas.

classes.0: MSI tumor with dense lymphocytic infiltration, mucinous or medullary features, and reduced gland formation.
classes.1: MSS tumor with more conventional gland-forming adenocarcinoma morphology and less prominent immune infiltration.
